hypothesis: Rolling time-series momentum on intraday bars: the sign of the recent price change (close.diff(n) on tf-minute bars), or the sign of a fast-minus-slow EMA spread, predicts the next bar's direction strongly enough to pay costs, with one common specification on every locally available futures market. Expected sign: positive net expectancy of holding the signal's direction.
disclosure_before_freeze: No return of these rules was computed on any real instrument before the freeze. The runner was validated on synthetic data only (self-test).

Prior information already seen in this repo: (a) intraday_momentum_cross_asset_phase1_20261111 (open -> open+h, hold to close) was REJECTED on IS the same day: gross effect positive in all 15 cells, below costs in 11, only MBT positive; (b) ma_crossover_trend (EMA 9/21 on 15-minute bars WITH an ADX > 20 filter) was tested on MNQ, MGC, MCL, 6E, ZN and MBT and never retained; (c) atr_trend_flip (supertrend 15 min) was tested on every asset and is now MNQ shadow only; (d) close-of-day momentum is CLOSED_COST_CONSTRAINED.

This campaign is a new pre-registered hypothesis (continuous rolling signal, position held and flipped bar by bar), not a rescue of the open-anchored rule. It was requested explicitly after that rejection.
6E, ZN and MCL are not tested: their one-minute files are no longer on disk.
Session coverage per instrument is known from the previous campaign (counts only): MBT is thin in IS (116, 162, 81 eligible sessions in 2021-2023), MGC has no eligible session before 2016-02.

pre_sample_holdout_universe.MGC: same file and contract as in universe

session.bar_semantics: one-minute bars stamped at bar start; minute index m = minutes since session_start, 0 <= m < session_minutes; weekdays only
session.open_price: open of the first one-minute bar with 0 <= m <= 4
session.exit_price: close of the last one-minute bar with session_minutes-5 <= m <= session_minutes-1
session.eligibility: at least 75% of the session's one-minute bars present, open_price and exit_price available, a single instrument_id over the session
session.tf_bars: tf-minute bars aligned on session_start: bar b covers session minutes [b*tf, (b+1)*tf); O = first available one-minute open in the bar, C = last available one-minute close; the last bar may be partial; empty bars are skipped

signals.series: tf bars of all eligible sessions concatenated in time order (RTH only, overnight excluded from the bar sequence, but the price change across sessions is part of the signal)
signals.diff: s = sign(ln C_t - ln C_{t-n}); s = 0 if the two bars have different instrument_id or are more than 7 calendar days apart
signals.ema: s = sign(EMA_fast(ln C) - EMA_slow(ln C)), EMAs with adjust=False, restarted on each segment of constant instrument_id without a gap of more than 7 calendar days; s = 0 until the segment has at least slow bars
signals.no_filter: no ADX, volume, volatility or time filter

execution.decision: at the close of tf bar k of a session, target position = s_k in {-1, 0, +1}, one contract
execution.fill: the target is reached at O_{k+1}, the open of the next tf bar of the same session (first available one-minute open of that bar)
execution.last_bar: no decision at the close of the session's last tf bar; any position is closed at exit_price
execution.costs: each one-contract side costs tick_size * point_value (1 tick slippage) + commission_per_side; a flip from -1 to +1 is two sides

grid.note: Identical on every instrument. No per-asset parameter. Cell order: diff (tf major, n minor), then ema (tf major, pair minor).

unit: daily R = (gross USD - cost USD) / (point_value * open_price * sigma_day), sigma_day = sqrt(mean of ln(exit_price/open_price)^2 over the 20 previous eligible sessions), at least 15 values (causal). Sessions without sigma_day are dropped. USD per contract per day is reported alongside.

pooling.rule: per day, average R across eligible instruments inside each cluster, then average across clusters with at least one eligible instrument that day

selection_rule.statistic: daily Sharpe of the pooled net R series on IS for each cell, then neighbourhood smoothing inside each family's 2-D grid: average of the cell and its orthogonal neighbours
selection_rule.choice: the single cell with the highest smoothed Sharpe over the 32 cells; ties broken by cell order
selection_rule.executed: that one cell, the same on every instrument

tests_on_IS.hac: Newey-West t of the mean of the pooled net R series, 5 lags
tests_on_IS.max_stat_permutation: 5000 draws; each draw flips the sign of the gross PnL of whole days (same flip for every instrument and cell, costs still paid); statistic = maximum smoothed Sharpe over the 32 cells; p = share of draws >= observed. Seed 20261111.
tests_on_IS.cscv: 12 contiguous time blocks, all 924 half/half splits; the selection rule is applied on the train half; logit of the relative rank of the chosen cell's Sharpe on the test half; PBO = share of splits with logit <= 0
diagnostics_not_gated: all 32 cells pooled, per cluster and per instrument, gross and net
signal delayed by one extra tf bar

all_required: G1: selected cell pooled IS mean net R > 0 with HAC t >= 2.0
G4: selected cell net mean R > 0 on IS in at least 2 of 3 clusters and at least 3 of 5 instruments
G5: more than half of IS calendar years have a positive pooled net sum
G6: selected cell on PRE (NQ 2010-06 -> 2019-05 with NQ costs, MGC, cluster-balanced) has mean net R > 0 with HAC t >= 1.0
gate_to_OOS.if_pass: the user is asked before OOS is read; the same code and the same selected cell are then applied once to OOS as a verdict
gate_to_OOS.if_fail: OOS is not computed; hypothesis closed on this data

pass_if_all: pooled OOS mean net R > 0 with HAC t >= 1.0
net mean R > 0 in at least 2 of 3 clusters
oos_verdict.EXT: reported for MNQ, MGC and MBT only, informational

prohibitions: no other timeframe, lookback, EMA pair, dead band, filter, stop or holding rule after the freeze
no OOS before the IS gate is evaluated and the user has approved the read
